request.style: English, male baritone solo with gentle choir, acoustic guitar, soft piano, cello, light drums, reverent and hopeful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Two names stood before the praying room
Joseph called Justus sought the light
A witness to the risen Lord
From John's baptism to the final flight

[Chorus]
Show us which of these you chose
Lord you know the human heart
The lot fell not on Justus
But the witness role was marked

[Verse]
In the upper room they gathered one hundred and twenty
Praying with the women and the mother Mary
He walked with Jesus all the days
An eyewitness to the victory

[Chorus]
Show us which of these you chose
Lord you know the human heart
The lot fell not on Justus
But the witness role was marked

[Bridge]
Matthias took the twelfth seat
Justus remained in faithful love
The ministry continued on
Witnessing the words of God above

[Outro]
One of these must become a witness
Of the resurrection and the truth
